# Marketplace Listing Skill

This skill turns your photos and description into a ready to post marketplace listing. You confirm the sold items used for pricing, and you answer the one condition question photos cannot settle. It drafts a title and description, suggests a price range, and never presents that range as a guaranteed sale price.

- Listing: https://theskillharbor.com/products/marketplace-listing-skill

- Price: Free

2. Copy the install package from the page.
3. Paste it into Muse and follow the steps there.
